rec.notes: The rectum begins at the third sacral vertebra (Mannan 14th ed., p. 385 (PDF p. 403) and p. 563 'Levels' (PDF p. 581)). It passes down in the concavity of the sacrum; dilated (ampulla) at the level of the coccyx (Mannan 14th ed., p. 385 (PDF p. 403)). Anal canal: below the pelvic diaphragm, 3.8 cm long (Mannan 14th ed., p. 385 (PDF p. 403)).

Its lowest part is the upper anal canal (the CT label does not separate them; the internal sphincter is inside this wall; the lower anal canal is not in the source).
